item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】WAV - Aerosmith & Friends @ Hollywood Bowl 2026-11-01 (Raw Wav)
item.description:
Hidden Content:
You must either reply or click 'Like' to see the hidden information contained here.
It didn't rain and my baggie with dry socks cleared the checkpoint along with everything else this time.

I was on the fence because Thursday was so stressful and not fun, other than the satisfaction of pulling it off after a major setback that should have prohibited me from attending.

Anyway I got in a song late and for awhile I am running internals til 19:12 set one and shuffling things in my pockets getting situated since I ditched a paper Trader Joe's back that was coming part.

A blog user from Romania wanted to meet and it didn't work on Thursday since I got in really late and didn't want to leave my seat and figured that was worth at least going to Hollywood for. But since I was there ... it's attempting either Aerosmith or Dixie Chicks. Since it didn't rain it sent demand into the stratosphere. Once again got a free one. Getting the ticket itself didn't play out as usual but that's a story for another day. Mailing my autographed Walk This Way book from 1997 tomorrow though it wasn't part of the deal.

Unfortunately really clear and windy and this time I wore a full suit but no real good place to put my mics, with no screens. Usually they go fine under a T shirt not polyester or whatever this shirt was made of and a blazer in the way. So there could be some issues but also just assuming other people are rolling. Never went to my seat just standing in the walkway between J and N or whatever. Wind blowing the sound around and people walking in front of me. But at least I could see what was going on and enjoy it a lot more than I did Thursday.

No repeat GNR set! Unlike Monday with it's abrupt walk off, they hung around a bit but it sure feels like the end for real. We'll see.
